product_name_specific: Marco Polo, Marco Polo Activity, Marco Polo Horizon
risk_description: Dismantling or assembly of the back-up battery may lead to damage to the wiring harness due to changes in the installation space. This may lead to an increased risk of fire.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
